A fix release for the market-data connection. No API changes.

## Fixed

- **A request sent as its connection closes fails at once instead of waiting.** A request queued at the instant its market-data connection ended could stay queued until another call reached the same channel, and with the per-call deadline disabled (`timeout_ms = 0`, or `with_deadline(Duration::ZERO)` in Rust) that wait had no bound. Each connection's request queue is now released the moment the connection ends, so such a request fails with a connection-closed error, which the retry path treats as transient and re-sends on a fresh connection. Applies to every binding, the local server and the MCP server. (#1405)

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/userFRM/ThetaDataDx/blob/v0.5.1/CHANGELOG.md) for every change and the reason for it.
